query:
SELECT l.id, l.loanNumber, b.firstName, b.lastName, COUNT(a.id) as schedule_count 
FROM loans l 
LEFT JOIN borrowers b ON l.borrowerId = b.id 
LEFT JOIN amortization_schedule a ON l.id = a.loanId 
GROUP BY l.id 
HAVING schedule_count = 0;
